title: Matter Command Round-Trip Outlier
app: Home Assistant, Matter and Thread border routers, Alexa routine logs, Google Home automations, Zigbee2MQTT bridges, SmartThings, Node-RED, and webhooks streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=matter:event event_type=command
| stats avg(round_trip_ms) as avg_round_trip_ms, max(round_trip_ms) as max_round_trip_ms by cluster command_name
| where avg_round_trip_ms>1500 OR max_round_trip_ms>5000
| sort - avg_round_trip_ms
description: Uses Matter command telemetry telemetry to monitor round-trip time by cluster and command in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for commands that are much slower than users expect, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Matter command telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Cluster and command table of average round-trip latency.
grandmaExplanation: It builds round-trip time by cluster and command so you can spot commands that are much slower than users expect before it becomes annoying.
